svg.aria-label: Three panels: jazz dance grew out of jazz music — in 1920s America jazz was improvised and syncopated, and people danced to it; it is not a fixed set of steps but slamming on the heavy beats, moving the body in parts, adding your own flourishes; later it split into social swing, Broadway stage jazz and street jazz funk, which is what most classes teach today. Bottom line: jazz dance is not a tune, it is how you move to the tune.

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

svg.text: Jazz dance: born from jazz music
